description: An event published when a toxic is added to or removed from the links of an instance, one event per toxic, carrying the toxic as it was applied
title: io.synadia.ntf.event.v1.toxic_action

id.description: Unique id of this event, a nuid

timestamp.description: The publisher's clock when the event was made, in RFC 3339 with nanoseconds

instance_id.description: The instance the event is about

source.description: The component that published the event

source_seq.description: Counts the source's events for the instance from 1 with no gaps

action.description: What happened to the toxic, cleared when every toxic was removed at once

name.description: The toxic's name, unique on the instance

selector.description: The links the toxic acts on

kind.description: route, gateway or client; absent selects every kind

from.description: A node or a cluster at one end of the links

to.description: A node or a cluster at the other end of the links, or the server of a client link

node.description: Selects every link of one node, both ways

toxic_type.description: The toxic's type, such as cut, latency or lossy

attributes.description: The toxic's attributes as applied; absent when there are none, such as for a cut

toxicity.description: The chance that the toxic acts, as applied: 1 when the request left it out

links.description: The names of the links the selector resolved to
